svg.text: CANONICAL UI FOUNDATION · LITERAL SCALE STUDY
DIRECTION A CURRENT PIXELS · LIGHT/DARK THEME SURFACES · NO PRODUCTION CHANGE
Icons are judged at 24 px and 16 px; cursors at 32 px and 24 px. The 128 px cell shows the source geometry, not intended UI display size.
Do these current silhouettes, crops, and stroke weights read well enough to freeze as the first canonical UI SVG family?
